name: rockett-cad
description: Self-hosted, browser-based parametric CAD for 3D printing (B-Rep kernel, feature timeline)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared --if-present && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p client
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace server && npm run test:client
